<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="phraseBlur" x="-10%" y="-30%" width="120%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4.2"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".28"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#08080C"/>
  <rect x="0" y="27" width="390" height="1" fill="#212131" opacity=".65"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="16" x2="321" y2="10" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="8" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="331" y2="6" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="12" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="346.5" y1="14.5" x2="350" y2="18" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="7" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="361.5" y="9.5" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
  <rect x="381.5" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FAFAFD"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,58 24,65 31,72" fill="none" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="65" x2="39" y2="65" stroke="#FAFAFD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="70" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Backup wallet</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="348" y="51" width="26" height="26" rx="6" fill="#212131" stroke="#38384D"/>
      <line x1="356" y1="59" x2="366" y2="69" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="366" y1="59" x2="356" y2="69" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- progress -->
  <text x="24" y="111" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">SECURITY CHECK</text>
  <text x="343" y="111" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">2 of 3</text>
  <rect x="24" y="121" width="342" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#29293D"/>
  <rect x="24" y="121" width="228" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#3ED9A4"/>

  <!-- intro -->
  <text x="24" y="164" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="25px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Your secret phrase</text>
  <text x="24" y="190" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Write these words down in order and keep them</text>
  <text x="24" y="210" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">somewhere safe. Never share them with anyone.</text>

  <!-- phrase card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="22" y="236" width="346" height="244" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity=".34"/>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="234" width="342" height="244" rx="8" fill="#212131" stroke="#38384D"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="40" y="250" width="310" height="48" rx="8" fill="#181825"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="274" r="12" fill="#6966FF" opacity=".2"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="274" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="278" x2="70" y2="282" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="82" y="270" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="13.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Tap to reveal your phrase</text>
  <text x="82" y="287" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Make sure nobody is looking</text>

  <!-- blurred 12 words -->
  <g filter="url(#phraseBlur)" opacity=".92">
    <text x="51" y="330" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">1  river</text>
    <text x="188" y="330" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">2  maple</text>
    <text x="51" y="366" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">3  orbit</text>
    <text x="188" y="366" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">4  canvas</text>
    <text x="51" y="402" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">5  silent</text>
    <text x="188" y="402" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">6  harbor</text>
    <text x="51" y="438" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">7  lunar</text>
    <text x="188" y="438" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">8  velvet</text>
    <text x="51" y="466" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">9  bright</text>
    <text x="188" y="466" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">10  meadow</text>
    <text x="51" y="494" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">11  coast</text>
    <text x="188" y="494" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">12  amber</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="40" y="315" width="310" height="171" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".025"/>

  <!-- warning -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="502" width="342" height="76" rx="8" fill="#E4555524" stroke="#E4555550"/>
    <polygon points="48,524 57,541 39,541" fill="none" stroke="#E45555" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="529" x2="48" y2="535" stroke="#E45555" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="538" r="1" fill="#E45555"/>
    <text x="70" y="530" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="13.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Keep this phrase private</text>
    <text x="70" y="550" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#C8C7D8">Anyone with these words can access your wallet.</text>
    <text x="70" y="566" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#C8C7D8">dYdX support will never ask for it.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- confirmation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="598" width="17" height="17" rx="4" fill="#3ED9A4" stroke="#3ED9A4"/>
    <polyline points="28,606 32,610 38,603" fill="none" stroke="#08080C" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="51" y="611" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#C8C7D8">I have securely stored my recovery phrase</text>
  </g>

  <!-- action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="639" width="165" height="45" rx="6" fill="#303045" stroke="#38384D"/>
    <circle cx="77" cy="661" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="81" y="665" width="8" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="103" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Copy phrase</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="639" width="165" height="45" rx="6" fill="#3ED9A4"/>
    <text x="283.5" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#08080C">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="338,656 343,661 338,666" fill="none" stroke="#08080C" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="716" width="390" height="128" fill="#181825"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="716" x2="390" y2="716" stroke="#303045" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,753 48,745 57,753 57,764 51,764 51,756 45,756 45,764 39,764" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="784" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <line x1="111" y1="747" x2="111" y2="765" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="103" y1="754" x2="119" y2="754" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="111" cy="756" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="111" y="784" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Trade</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="171" y="745" width="26" height="20" rx="5" fill="#6966FF" opacity=".18"/>
    <line x1="176" y1="760" x2="181" y2="755" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="755" x2="186" y2="758" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="186" y1="758" x2="192" y2="749" stroke="#6966FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="184" y="784" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#6966FF">Portfolio</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="245" y="746" width="18" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="249" y1="750" x2="259" y2="750" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="249" y1="755" x2="259" y2="755" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="254" y="784" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Activity</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="331" cy="750" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="331" cy="762" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="331" y="784" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="148" y="825" width="94" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FAFAFD" opacity=".22"/>
</svg>
